fact_sheet_status.notes: Excel Col H blank, but matching public folder found in Drive master folder

min_standing_note.notes: No specific semester-count prerequisite listed in WSU 2026-27 or 2025-26 Fact Sheets (exchange open to UG/GR per Excel, though 500+ grad courses closed per Fact Sheet p.2).

excluded_majors.notes: Courses outside the Pullman campus and 500+ graduate-level courses are not open to exchange students (further restrictions under Academics tab in myStudyAbroad).

min_gpa_host.notes: Good academic standing via home university/WSU 4.0 grading system noted on 2025-26 p.1; no fixed numeric incoming-exchange GPA threshold stated in Fact Sheets.

instruction_languages.notes: All courses are taught in English.

english_course_availability.notes: US land-grant research university teaching all courses in English.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: English test within past 2 years: Duolingo 105, IELTS 6.5, or TOEFL iBT 4 (2026 ETS 1-6 scale; 2025-26 sheet listed TOEFL iBT 79). Or qualify for Waiver Option E or F at https://ip.wsu.edu/future-students/requirements/.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall Term (incl. exams): Mon Aug 24 - Fri Dec 18, 2026 (Mandatory Orientation Friday before first day of classes).

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Spring Term (incl. exams): Mon Jan 11 - Fri May 7, 2027 (Mandatory Orientation Friday prior).

tuition_model.notes: Bilateral exchange covers standard 12-18 credit load (base tuition omitted from COA table p.3); >18 credit overload incurs per-credit tuition (~$577.75/cr as of 2023 per 2025-26 p.1).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived monthly cost from WSU 2024-25 Cost of Attendance (latest published itemized sheet in Drive) divided by 5 months: Room & Board $8,887 + Books & Supplies $381 + Transportation/Misc $1,821 = $11,089/semester -> $2,217.80/mo (~$2,218/mo). Total COA incl. Mandatory Fees ($794) + Health Insurance ($1,100 Fall / $1,532 Spring) = $12,933/sem ($25,866/AY).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate derived from monthly USD range 2,218/month. No FX conversion (1 USD = 1.0 USD; 5-month equivalent = 5 * 2,218.0 USD = 11,090.00 USD), calculated 2026-11-15.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: 2024-25 Fact Sheet baseline per semester: Mandatory Fees $794/sem + mandatory WSU International Student Health Insurance $1,100 (Fall) / $1,532 (Spring/Summer) / $2,632 (AY) — strict US-comparable waiver rules (most students double-covered).

housing_availability.notes: 2026-27 Fact Sheet p.2 states 'On-campus housing is guaranteed'; 2025-26 p.3 notes all exchange students are required to live in University housing (residence halls or University apartments) during vacation periods as well.

housing_notes.value: Arranged via WSU Housing & Residence Life (http://housing.wsu.edu/); variable dining plans available in residence halls (~$8,887/sem combined room & board in 2024-25 COA).

host_grants_or_stipends.value: None; 2025-26 Fact Sheet p.3 explicitly states 'Exchange students are not eligible to apply for University scholarships'.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Visa (Form DS-2019) requires proof of funding equating the billable Cost of Attendance under myStudyAbroad Costs tab (Certificate of Finances; $12,933/sem or $25,866/AY in 2024-25 baseline).

course_catalog_url.notes: Live term schedule of classes also linked on 2026-27 p.2 at https://schedules.wsu.edu/.

english_course_list_url.notes: All courses in https://schedules.wsu.edu/ and http://catalog.wsu.edu/Pullman/Courses are taught in English; no separate English-only URL.

credit_system_and_load.value: US semester credit hours (1 cr = 15 in-class hrs; most courses 3 cr). Limit: 12 credits min (immigration floor) to 18 credits max; 15 credits recommended (>18 cr billed extra per credit).

course_restrictions_note.value: Restricted to WSU Pullman campus (100-400 undergraduate levels; 500+ graduate courses and non-Pullman campuses excluded); prerequisites enforced and preferred courses cannot be guaranteed.

value: Online nomination (Signature Verification Form, signed ID/Passport copy, Official Transcripts, optional Language of Instruction letter)
Proof of English proficiency (within 2 years, or Waiver Option E/F)

academic_style.value: US public land-grant research university (~15:1 student-faculty ratio, 200+ study fields; syllabi strictly enforce assignment due dates even without in-class reminders).

city_tier.notes: pullman.wsu.edu explicitly describes WSU Pullman as 'Located in a classic college town' (2025-26 Fact Sheet p.1 gives town population ~31,000).

campus_type.notes: Pullman campus set in Palouse agricultural/wheat region (2025-26 p.1); no explicit rural vs suburban enum term used.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: Not explicitly rated in Fact Sheets or wsu.edu (US English-speaking college town).

international_support_services.value: WSU Education Abroad / Office of International Programs, mandatory Orientation, Pullman Regional Airport arrival pickup (or Spokane shuttle), Cougar Health insurance, Recreation Center, 250+ clubs.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall/AY: Nomination Apr 1, Application Apr 15. Spring/Calendar Year: Nomination Oct 1, Application Oct 15 (note: 2026-27 Fact Sheet p.1 erroneously transposed Fall/Spring headings vs 2025-26 Fact Sheet p.2 and ip.wsu.edu).
